contract: Separate fresh/resume/snapshot instructions and retain native MCP credentials byte-for-byte in the owning child tool store; no native methods or acceptance conditions changed. Existing workers retain old open shell inode and old prompt; new workers alone use this source. Origin retry is explicit, requires a dead failed worker with closed native ownership, unchanged previously admitted origin and no accepted current revision; preserves all old runs. After each newly created diagnostic repair, parent explicitly invokes guarded existing native stage-terminal recovery before replacement stages; never clears current-revision terminals or live ownership. Same-run repair resumes recognize native reused prefix stages only with exact repair-route provenance and active-revision artifact paths; opt-in exporting snapshot repair runs are eligible, stage-only snapshots remain excluded. Fresh raw-image launches additionally decode and hash-check each queue input and publish an immutable native copy before initialization; submitted images do not alter the nine-image runtime qualification fixture. User-authorized continuation experiments pass the official diagnostic version budget into a new public snapshot run, preserve old native budgets and all archives, and require unchanged parent/origin hashes, closed ownership and native snapshot preflight; strict-accepted assets remain ineligible.
